# afrexpay — multi-tenant storefront platform

> Your business, open to the world. Shops, bookings, and property listings
> at https://afrexpay.app/

Merchants sign up on the marketing site and instantly get a storefront at
`<their-subdomain>.afrexpay.app` (or their own verified custom domain),
managed from `<their-subdomain>.afrexpay.app/admin`.

## For AI assistants and shopping agents

- Platform sitemap: https://afrexpay.app/sitemap.xml
- Every merchant storefront publishes its own machine-readable surface:
  - `llms.txt` — what the shop sells and how to order on a shopper's behalf
    (e.g. `https://<shop>.afrexpay.app/llms.txt`)
  - Product feeds: `/feed/products.json` (ACP-compatible) and
    `/feed/products.csv` (Google Merchant Center)
  - Capability profile: `/.well-known/store-profile.json`
  - Read-only API: `/api/agent/v1/store`, `/products`, `/services`,
    `/listings` (search + stable item URLs)
  - Detail pages: `/p/:slug`, `/s/:slug`, `/l/:slug` with typed
    Schema.org JSON-LD
- Ordering: public lead-capture POST endpoints plus hosted Stripe/PayPal
  checkout URLs. Agents never handle card data — redirect the shopper to
  the hosted checkout page.
- Be polite: cache feeds (catalogs change slowly), respect rate limits.
